dedupe_keys.name: vert 1 0 an r package for estimating road transport emissions from traffic flows

description: Giorgio Veratti publishes VERT, an R package that estimates road-transport emissions from traffic flows. Zenodo provides version 1.0 under GPL 3.0 or later. The description says the package combines traffic estimates with vehicle-fleet composition following the EMEP/EEA emissions methodology and produces estimates for pollutants and greenhouse gases. A transport modeller can use these outputs when testing traffic assignments, fleet changes or road policies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers VERT. Coverage is whatever area and period the user supplies in traffic and fleet inputs, not a bundled global emissions inventory. A limitation is that the public page does not specify all vehicle categories, emission-factor vintages or spatial output formats; those details require package documentation before mixing scenarios. Emissions estimates inherit uncertainty in flow and fleet assumptions. The package archive was not downloaded or installed, and no emission estimate or benchmark was recalculated.
